title: Wealth
tagline: A wealth management mobile app with CDP smart wallet + AI agent for emerging markets
description:
This project is an onchain wealth management app for the emerging-market middle class — think “Robinhood + high-yield savings,” but permissionless and global. Instead of being stuck in fragile local currencies and low bank rates, users can move into dollar-denominated, yield-bearing stablecoins (USD+) and tokenized U.S. stocks.

Onboarding is powered by a CDP embedded smart wallet, so users don’t need seed phrases or prior Web3 experience. They land in a simple mobile-first interface where they can deposit from an exchange or self-custody wallet and allocate into “vaults” that hold USD+ or tokenized equities via Dinari’s sandbox on Polygon testnet.

An integrated AI agent (built with CDP AgentKit) turns natural-language requests into onchain actions. A user can say “invest $50 into U.S. stocks every month” or “move my savings to a safer, yield-earning vault,” and the agent reads their positions, simulates the trade, and proposes a transaction for them to approve via the smart wallet. The goal is to make sophisticated, global wealth tools accessible in a few taps.
